title: DeathSlimeSwap
description: Kinda simple death swap plugin with options for multiple players, random items option and easy customizability
body: Basically works as many more death swap plugins, this one works for 2, 3 and 4 players, when obne dies, give them spectator mode and the plugin will count only the players that are alive. You can set how many players can play, set timer, stop start and check status.
